Description

The Hive London is the largest football facility in Europe with many synthetic pitches available for leisure play. They have FIFA Pro 2* 5-a-sides and 11-a-side quality surface!

They have so many facilities to choose from: 9x 5-a-side pitches, 3x 11-a-side pitches, 6x 7-a-side pitches, 2x 9-a-side pitches!


To book please visit: https://thehivelondon.com/
